title: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
administering_authority: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA), Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance, Government of India
summary: Atal Pension Yojana provides a guaranteed minimum monthly pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 from age 60 until death to eligible unorganised workers, with spouse pension continuation and corpus return to nominees.

benefits.description: Guaranteed minimum monthly pension of ₹1,000, ₹2,000, ₹3,000, ₹4,000, or ₹5,000 per month starting at age 60 until death, depending on entry age and chosen contribution tier.
conditions: Subscriber must make continuous auto-debit contributions until age 60
Spouse is entitled to same pension amount upon subscriber demise until spouse death
Accumulated pension corpus returned to nominee upon demise of both subscriber and spouse

rules.explanation: Applicant must be at least 18 years of age.
Applicant must not be older than 40 years of age to join APY.
From 1st October 2022, any citizen who is or has been an income-tax payer is not eligible to join APY.
Applicant must possess an active savings bank or post office savings account for auto-debit.

required_documents.name: Savings Bank / Post Office Account Passbook
required_documents.condition: Mandatory for setting up automated recurring debit instructions

application_steps.description: Visit bank branch or post office where savings bank account is maintained, or access netbanking portal.
Fill out the APY Registration Form with personal, bank account, and nominee details.
Select the desired monthly pension tier (₹1,000 to ₹5,000) and contribution frequency (monthly, quarterly, or half-yearly).
Provide written or electronic consent for recurring auto-debit of contribution from savings account.
Obtain PRAN acknowledgment receipt upon successful enrolment.
